from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInvestmentCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Investment activity cash flow reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported")
    investment_cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="The investment activity cash flow net amount; positive or negative as reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. 'RMB', 'CNY', 'yuan'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024 Q1'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the cash flow figure and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_investment_cash_flows: list[CompanyInvestmentCashFlow]
